div.head: II As 24.1
div.ab: And þæt nán ceaping ne sy Sunnandagum; gif hit hwa dó, ðolige ðæs ceapgyld ⁊ sylle XXX scill.
⁊ ðæt nan cyping ne sy Sunnondagum; gif hit ðonne hwa dó, þolige ðæs ceapes ⁊ gesylle XXX scll' (to wite).

Et non sint mercata aliqua (fiat aliqua negotiatio uel forensis actio) die dominica. Si quis hoc faciat (presumat), perdat suum ceapgildum (ipsum captale) et soluat XXX sol. (emendet ouerhyrnessam meam).
⁊ ðæt nan cyping ne sy Sunnondagum; gif hit ðonne hwa dó, þolige ðæs ceapes ⁊ gesylle XXX scll' to wite.
And no trading shall take place on Sundays; and if anyone does so he shall lose the goods and pay a fine of 30 shillings.
Und dass kein Kaufen an Sonntagen geschehe; wenn das aber jemand thut, verliere er das Kaufgut und zahle 30 Schill. (zur Strafe H).
And that no buying take place on Sundays; but if anyone does that, let him lose the goods bought and pay 30 shillings (as a fine, H).
